notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: We made a small update. We fixed some minor bugs in the previous version. If the game is stuck on the login screen or if you encounter any other problem, it has been fixed with this update. If the error persists or if you encounter any other problem, please contact us via discord. Thank you for your patience!
